nodes.label: hubconf._create
nodes.desc: Shared torch.hub factory: downloads weights, calls attempt_load, optionally wraps AutoShape.

nodes.label: detect.parse_opt
nodes.desc: argparse spec for weights, source, imgsz, conf/iou thresholds and save flags.

nodes.label: detect.run
nodes.desc: End-to-end inference loop: setup, LoadImages, forward, NMS, scaling, annotator, save/crop.

nodes.label: export.run
nodes.desc: Drives model export to TorchScript, ONNX, TensorRT, TF and other formats with validation.

nodes.label: yolov5s.yaml
nodes.desc: Declarative layer list with from/-indices, repeats, anchors, depth/width multiples.

nodes.label: parse_model
nodes.desc: Materializes yaml rows into modules, applies gd/gw scaling and saves stride/channels.

nodes.label: DetectionModel
nodes.desc: Builds layers via parse_model, computes strides by dry forward, inits biases, fuses on demand.

nodes.label: BaseModel
nodes.desc: Shared forward/profile/fuse logic that DetectionModel and ClassifyModel extend.

nodes.label: _forward_once
nodes.desc: Runs each module, wiring saved feature outputs according to the from indices.

nodes.label: Detect
nodes.desc: Anchor head: 1x1 conv per scale, sigmoid split, xy/wh decoded against grid and anchors.

nodes.label: Detect._make_grid
nodes.desc: Builds meshgrid plus anchor_grid buffers whenever input spatial shape changes.

nodes.label: Conv
nodes.desc: conv-bn-activation block whose padding comes from autopad.

nodes.label: autopad
nodes.desc: Infers same-shape padding from kernel size, honoring dilation.

nodes.label: Bottleneck
nodes.desc: 3x3 then 1x1 conv pair with optional residual shortcut.

nodes.label: C3
nodes.desc: CSP block: two conv stems, n Bottlenecks in one branch, concat then 1x1.

nodes.label: SPPF
nodes.desc: Sequential 5x5 max-pools emulate SPP kernels at lower cost.

nodes.label: DetectMultiBackend
nodes.desc: Dispatches on weight suffix to pt/ONNX/TRT/TF/OpenVINO/CoreML/paddle/triton runtimes.

nodes.label: attempt_load
nodes.desc: torch.load with allowlist, optional fuse=True, returns model or Ensemble of weights.

nodes.label: AutoShape
nodes.desc: Hub-friendly wrapper: accepts paths/PIL/numpy, letterboxes, NMSes, scales boxes back.

nodes.label: LoadImages
nodes.desc: Iterator over images and video frames yielding im, im0s, cap metadata.

nodes.label: letterbox
nodes.desc: Aspect-preserving resize plus gray padding; auto=True minimizes padding for strides.

nodes.label: check_img_size
nodes.desc: Rounds requested imgsz up to the nearest multiple of the model stride.

nodes.label: non_max_suppression
nodes.desc: confidence mask, box conversion, class offset trick, torchvision.ops.nms, max_det cap.

nodes.label: scale_boxes
nodes.desc: Maps padded-letterbox coordinates back to original image pixels, optional clip.

nodes.label: increment_path
nodes.desc: Creates run/exp style save dirs or suffixed file names, exist_ok aware.

nodes.label: select_device
nodes.desc: Resolves ''/'cpu'/gpu id to a torch device, honoring CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.

nodes.label: fuse_conv_and_bn
nodes.desc: Folds batchnorm into conv weights/bias for a faster single-op inference path.

nodes.label: check_anchors
nodes.desc: K-means recomputation of anchors when dataset wh ratios drift past threshold.

nodes.label: ComputeLoss
nodes.desc: Builds targets against anchor t, box/obj/cls BCE+IoU losses across detection layers.

nodes.label: ap_per_class
nodes.desc: TP/FP matching to precision-recall curves and per-class AP for val.py.

nodes.label: export_onnx
nodes.desc: torch.onnx.export with dynamic axes and onnx-simplifier post pass.

nodes.label: export_engine
nodes.desc: Builds a serialized TensorRT engine from the ONNX graph with workspace/precision flags.
